name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Platform Implementation Manager role on the Commerce Platform team, and I'm based in the Denver metro. The quarterback framing is exactly how I've worked for 15 years: I own the post-sale launch, coordinate the internal and external moving pieces, troubleshoot what breaks, and get merchants live and confident on the product.

The fit is direct. I led onboarding and launch for a high-value SMB and e-commerce portfolio at Wix as a launch specialist and team lead, project-managing setups and keeping them on timeline. At Birdeye I ran onboarding and technical troubleshooting for a high-volume partner network and kept all but one account (about 94% retention), while feeding structured product feedback back to Product and Engineering. And at Fivestars I onboarded SMB and restaurant merchants onto a loyalty and marketing platform, so merchant setup, education, and loyalty/gift program adoption in the restaurant world is familiar ground, not a learning curve.

What I'd bring on day one is calm ownership of messy implementations: clear communication when a merchant is frustrated, the tech-savviness to dig into a website or product issue before escalating, and the instinct to spot the workflow fixes that make the whole team faster. I'd welcome the conversation.
Thank you for your time and consideration.
